The anonymous public NED TAP service documents programmatic cone searches of the NED Object Directory and requests NED acknowledgment. CTAS retains bounded source-native rows and provenance only. NOIRLab's provider-owned API authentication notebook states that anyone may retrieve public files while proprietary-file retrieval requires authorization. This adapter sends no credential and retains a product only after an exact file-metadata lookup supplies a nonblank release_date no later than the query time. rules.missed: a host not in the retained catalogues counts as one candidate at f = missedFractionalOffset
rules.offset: f = separation / directional light radius (SIMBAD shape), else separation x kpc/arcsec(z) / physical scale, else separation / angular scale; term exp(-f); f > maxFractionalOffset gives 0
rules.probable: the top candidate is 'probable' when its posterior >= probablePosterior and >= probableRatio x the next hypothesis
rules.redshift: only when the transient and the candidate both have a redshift: exp(-0.5 (dz / sigma)^2), sigma^2 = sum of the stated errors^2 + floor^2

publication_revisions.abstract: We summarize the observations from the most recent ZTF experiment (AstroNote 2024-266, the Nightly-cadence Three-band Extragalactic Survey), conducted from 2024-09-22 02:38 UT to 2024-09-24 12:43 UT. A total of 78 extragalactic transients were identified. Of the 41 transients that met our selection criteria for spectroscopic follow-up, 38 were classified, while two were observed but remain unclassified, resulting in a classification completeness of 95% and a spectroscopic completeness of 97.6%.
